defects.title: Server accepts one uploaded file as every required document
defects.body: Premise: `uploadedPath` only tests the broad `pending/` prefix and absence of `..`, while every newly-required category is an independent array of that same schema. → Path: a direct `submitApplication` caller can upload one legitimate pending file (for example, a vacancy declaration) and repeat its path in `pai.documentos`, `mae.documentos`, `certidao_casamento`, address, income, bank, and both student arrays. `collectDocumentRows` then records that one file under each asserted category. → Verdict: direct Server Action submission bypasses the required distinct category contract, so an incomplete/fraudulent application is accepted despite the UI's separate fields.
defects.suggestion: Validate each submitted path against the expected pending category (and student index for student files), reject duplicate cross-category use, and retain that mapping when persisting document rows.
evidence: Premise: lib/validations/application-schema.ts:18-29 accepts only a broad pending path, not a field-specific category → Path: a direct submitApplication caller repeats one valid uploaded path in every required document array, which collectDocumentRows accepts at app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:252-290 → Verdict: the Server Action accepts an application without distinct required document categories.
lib/validations/application-schema.ts:18-29 → all required file arrays share a validator that does not inspect the category directory.
app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:252-290 → collectDocumentRows trusts the caller-selected payload field and assigns category metadata without checking the path's uploaded category.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_05.md requirements 5–8 and 15 → the Server Action must independently enforce each required category and only accept safe pending paths.

defects.title: Quick access still prioritizes the scholarship path
defects.body: Premise: the changed quick-access list renders `Formulário de bolsa` before `Seja um benfeitor`. → Path: a visitor using the landing footer's explicitly named quick-access surface encounters the scholarship journey first. → Verdict: this contradicts the required donor-first ordering for every quick-access surface and leaves a user-visible release criterion unmet.
defects.suggestion: Swap the two list items so the benefactor canonical link is first and the scholarship link remains second.
evidence: Premise: app/page.tsx:571-576 renders the scholarship quick-access link before the benefactor link → Path: visitors using the landing footer encounter the scholarship journey first → Verdict: the required donor-first quick-access order is violated.
app/page.tsx:571-576 → the footer's `Acesso rápido` list places `/solicitar-bolsa` before `/seja-um-benfeitor`.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_prd.md Core Features 1 → public quick-access links must list benefactor enrollment before scholarship applications.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_04.md requirement 5 → benefactor must precede scholarship in quick access.

suppressions.note: The legacy route contains only permanentRedirect to `/solicitar-bolsa`, while the canonical page declares `force-dynamic`.
